div.head: V Atr 32.5
div.ab: Ac þæt unriht alegde ure hlaford; þæt he ma mote.
Ac þæt unriht alegde ure hlaford; þæt he ma mote.
Ac þæt unriht alegde ure hlaford; þæt he ma mote.
Ac þæt unriht alegde ure hlaford. Þæt he ma mote!
Aber dieses Unrecht beseitigte unser Herr; dass er nur mehr [beseitigen] könne!
But our lord has put an end to this injustice; may he be able [to put an end to] more!
But this practice has been stopped by our lord. May he succeed in stopping more!
But our lord has suppressed that abuse. May he do more.
But our lord has brought an end to this wrongful practice. May he do so to others!
